topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining its historical perspective and core learning outcomes on transformation, oncogenes, and genetic instability.

topics.label: Discovery of tumor viruses and cellular transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the discovery of transforming viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays for testing cell transformation.

topics.label: Classification and mechanistic actions of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the classes of cancer mutations and illustrate how specific molecular mechanisms and protein structures govern their phenotypic effects.

topics.label: Mechanisms of genetic instability and multi-step tumor progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the cellular errors that generate genetic instability and explain how this instability accelerates stepwise tumor development.

topics.label: Hereditary cancer predisposition syndromes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inheriting germline mutations accelerates the pathway to malignancy and influences tumor evolution.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture by offering reading recommendations and previewing the subsequent lecture topic.
